verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a large library of community-contributed workflow templates (12,000+ 'from the n8n's Community'). It also shows that custom code can pull in npm packages, and community users mention custom node development and building new integrations. That points to an extensible ecosystem open to outside contributions, but no item documents installing community-built nodes or integrations as packages. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a community-node install mechanism (e.g. a community nodes registry or install UI/CLI), evidence of a third-party node catalog, and independent hands-on reports of installing community nodes.
